verification_contract.subject: generic callable and per-instantiation body facts
verification_contract.invalidation_case: One caller changes its generic argument from Nat 3 to Nat 4 while an independent Nat 2 caller remains unchanged.
verification_contract.unchanged_specialization_dependency_pres: N=2 specialization identity remains in entry_two dependencies

verification.workspace_cargo_fmt_check: reports existing formatting differences outside the changed test block; no repository-wide formatting was applied

scope: Language verifies generic specialization dependency identities for real front-end function-body facts. Changing one call from N=3 to N=4 rechecks its caller and the new specialization, while the existing N=2 caller and exact specialization body remain reusable. The suite also keeps unrelated imported and local facts reusable. This does not change compiler orchestration or establish production Test/Forge routing.
next_target: Pin this Language main in Compiler application-build and run the real mncs-test invalidation workload against the latest Language revision.
